Adding details from Vendor Ops:

- Marketplace nuance: AWS Marketplace often requires a Seller ID and a listing agreement copy before finance can map invoices to a contract. If CloudRetail invoices via marketplace, we need the exact Seller ID shown on the invoice (we use that to attach to the vendor code).
- Billing mapping: see attached sample mapping — please confirm the GL/account codes on your side so we can pre-map.
- Tax forms: W-9 is fine for US entities; if CloudRetail is contracting via a non-US entity we will need the appropriate tax residency docs.

Attachments: marketplace_billing_mapping.xlsx; seller_id_proof.png

Quick Q for Maya: do you anticipate purchase via AWS Private Offers, or will CloudRetail process through a standard marketplace procurement path? That affects whether we require a Private Offer agreement or a Marketplace invoice flow.
